purpose: Teach: 見送る/盗む/つど/痛快/くどい/本末転倒/滴/モニカ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、駅で、絶対、見送る、絶対、わね
lines.en: Sho, I promise I'll see you off at the station. I really mean it.
lines.style: Warm, present tone. Speaks directly to him with gentle certainty. No flourish — the reassurance is in the steadiness, not the volume. Eyes soft, voice stays low.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、絶対、人のもの、絶対、盗む、絶対、こと、絶対、しないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I promise I won't steal people's things. I really, really mean it.
lines.style: Solemn and clear, the way a child sounds when he's made a decision that matters. Steady pace. No rush. He's looking at her when he says it, wanting her to believe.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、翔くんと、絶対、会う、絶対、つど、絶対、嬉しいわ
lines.en: Every time I see you, Sho — I'm really happy. I mean that.
lines.style: Warm, almost wondering. Soft opening on the name. The happiness is genuine and a little surprised at itself. Slight trailing-off, like she's admitting something she didn't plan to say.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、新しいアニメ、絶対、痛快、絶対、で、絶対、面白いよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, there's this new anime that's really fun and exciting!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick pace, like he can barely hold the words in. Light and animated — he wants her to share his enthusiasm. No self-consciousness, just pure delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、お話、絶対、くどい、絶対、と、絶対、思わないわよ
lines.en: I don't think your stories are tedious at all, Sho. Not one bit.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. Not indulgent — she means this. Warm undertone of protection. She's reassuring him without making him feel like he needs reassuring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お勉強、絶対、忘れて、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、ばかりは、絶対、本末転倒、絶対、だよね
lines.en: Forgetting your homework just to play games — that's putting the cart before the horse, isn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful and slightly worried. Not scolding — observant. He's thinking out loud more than accusing. Small pause before the question, like he's working through it himself. Quiet, sincere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の葉の、本気で、絶対、雨の、絶対、滴、絶対、綺麗ね、翔くん
lines.en: Look how pretty the raindrops are on the leaves in the park, Sho.
lines.style: Hushed, almost reverent. She's pointing something out gently, inviting him to notice. Slow pace. The warmth is in the shared moment, not the words. Breath and stillness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、絵本の、絶対、モニカ、絶対、ちゃん、絶対、可愛いんだよ
lines.en: The character Monica in my picture book is really cute, Mei-sis!
lines.style: Excited and earnest. Quick, light energy — he's sharing something precious with her. Animated but not loud. There's tenderness underneath the brightness, like he chose to tell her this.
